programs.title: Lost Cities Revealed with Albert Lin
programs.desc:
Albert Lin explores ancient cities and learns the secrets of ancient builders.The respected scientist completed, among others:a search expedition for Genghis Khan's tomb in Mongolia.The researcher once again sets out on an extraordinary mission.Viewers will be able to watch him wander through the jungle, trying to find objects related to the Mayan settlement.As always, it is equipped with modern devices that allow you to scan the surroundings.The National Geographic envoy is not afraid of risk.He will break through untouched areas, cross wild rivers and slide down a rope into a giant cave.He will undertake all these daring feats to solve another mystery from the past
Albert Lin is an engineer and researcher at the University of California.He gained worldwide fame as a traveler and explorer who uses the latest technological achievements during his escapades.He reaches places inaccessible to average people - such as caves or hidden ruins of monumental buildings.His bionic leg prosthesis does not prevent him from performing feats requiring high physical fitness.The new series with his participation is a record of a fascinating expedition to ancient cities.Its motto is that history still hides many secrets from archaeologists that can revise our view of the past.Secrets of the Mayan Cradle Palenque is an archaeological site in Mexico.Here lived the people who built, among other things, the Temple of Inscriptions built on a step pyramid.Its discovery became a sensation, but this extraordinary place is still full of secrets.Modern technology allows you to explore the jungle, the bottom of a water-filled crater or the interior of a mountain in a way that was inaccessible to archaeologists of the past.Viewers will, among other things, witness Albert Lin's exciting descent into an underground cave.They will see what a traveler will discover in a place considered sacred.

programs.title: Inside NASA's Innovations
programs.desc: National Geographic inspires the explorer in everyone through breathtaking documentaries on science, history, and the natural wonders of our planet.

programs.title: Primal Survivor: Extreme African Safari
programs.desc:
Master survivalist Hazen Audel will undertake a demanding expedition through the Great Rift Valley, the largest continental rift in the world, which is considered a mecca for wildlife.It is also home to many nomadic tribes.The presenter does not hide the fact that completing the 800-kilometer route is one of his dreams.The traveler will set off during the animal migration season, which will allow him to admire animals living in the savannah up close.The six-episode series will present, among other things, an encounter with majestic elephants.Viewers will also have the opportunity to observe a million-strong flock of flamingos.The escapade would not have been possible without the help of local East Africans.Their invaluable tips allow you to move relatively safely in a land full of steep slopes
Master of survival Hazen Audel has been traveling through inaccessible corners of the globe for decades and popularizing the art of survival.Can find a common language with representatives of communities that live outside modern civilization.It uses their experience in dealing with the extreme challenges posed by nature untamed by humans.The latest series of the program with his participation is a record of a demanding expedition across the Great Rift Valley.The traveler does not hide the fact that completing the 800-kilometer route is one of his dreams.The land of nomads An exciting escapade begins during the animal migration season.Hazen Audel, who is a biologist by profession, has the opportunity to take a closer look at the representatives of the fauna living in this region.The success of his expedition would have been in doubt had it not been for the knowledge of the people of East Africa.In the first of six episodes of the series, viewers will accompany the documentarian on a journey through the Chalbi Desert in northern Kenya.It is inhabited by the Rendille and Gabbra peoples.The American will manage to find the camel caravan.He will talk to the group leader, who will not only provide him with help, but also explain the realities of life in this inhospitable corner of the globe.
